messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate from dedicated-eu-west-1 on prefix-serving path (api/v1/generate). Error signature suggests stale KV cache hits + incorrect prefix resolution. P95 latency also up ~120ms. Paging ml-oncall + platform-oncall.

zoe-ml-oncall: on it. Seeing a spike starting ~15m ago. Example failures show token mismatches; model returning stale cached completions for a small subset of requests. Suspect prefix cache TTL/eviction mismatch after recent kernel upgrade.

oliver-sre: confirmed rate of client-facing errors ~3% for dedicated-eu-west-1 pool, impacting 4 tenants (ids redacted). Traffic surge to fallback variant partially masking.

carla-eng-runtime: recent rollout 1764999000 pushed prefix-cache optimization that changes LRU window. Rolling back might be heavy; can we toggle bypass for affected tenants while we investigate?

zoe-ml-oncall: plan: 1) enable KV cache bypass for impacted tenants (serve correct but slightly slower) 2) disable prefix caching globally for prefix-tooling route if cheap toggle exists 3) apply per-tenant rate-limit to reduce error amplification and give time for processing.

oliver-sre: agree. I'll apply a short-term traffic-shaping policy to cap RPS from noisy tenants to 50% of baseline. That should reduce failure fanout.

carla-eng-runtime: commands ready. Using redwoodctl feature flags:

```
# bypass kv cache for tenant list
redwoodctl config set --scope tenants --ids "T-123,T-456,T-789" --set-prefix-kv-bypass=true --reason "incident 1765001234"

# disable prefix cache for service route
redwoodctl config set --route "api/v1/generate" --prefix-cache=off --reason "incident 1765001234"

# apply rate limit (RPS) to tenants
redwoodctl rate-limit set --tenants "T-123,T-456" --rps 25 --window 60 --reason "mitigation"
```

zoe-ml-oncall: executing step 1 now. Will watch error rate.

deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted for redwoodctl change job id=mit-1765001234. Changes will roll to dedicated-eu-west-1 in ~30s.

oliver-sre: rate-limit applied to T-123/T-456, KV bypass flag set for T-123/T-456/T-789. Observability: error-rate for T-123 dropped from 3.4% to 0.6% within 2 mins. P95 latency up ~80ms for those tenants (expected).

amy-support: heads up — Support: triaging customer tickets for those tenants. Sending proactive msg to account teams. Any quick wording?

amy-support: draft: "We're mitigating an internal caching inconsistency affecting completions for some requests. We've applied a temporary fix that preserves correctness but may increase latency. We're continuing to investigate and will update you within 1 hour."

zoe-ml-oncall: good. Also collecting failing request samples for repro. @carla please dump KV cache keys for one affected shard so we can inspect TTLs.

carla-eng-runtime: dumping now — attaching sample logs to incident artifact bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1765001234/samples.log (internal). Found entries where prefix token map pointed to stale KV object id.

dmitri-platform: adding traffic shaping at edge to flatten bursts. Also creating a temporary quota increase for other dependent tenants so they don't see throttles from re-routing. (quota bump scoped & audited).

oliver-sre: enabling additional logging to capture eviction events. If we see concurrent evictions + kernel path mismatch, that's the smoking gun.

zoe-ml-oncall: for correctness, we should keep KV-bypass for impacted tenants until we validate full rollback of the cache optimization or patch the eviction logic. Estimated time to patch: 3-6 hours.

amy-support: status page update in progress: "Partial degradation: some requests may return stale completions. Mitigation in place (cache bypass) — increased latency expected. Engineers are investigating. Next update in 60 minutes."

carla-eng-runtime: one more mitigation option: route affected tenant traffic to a different runtime variant that uses conservative cache settings (variant C). Can be done as failover:

```
redwoodctl route set --tenant T-789 --variant variant-c-conservative --reason "incident 1765001234 failover"
```

zoe-ml-oncall: let's do that for T-789 (customer reported major correctness regression). Execute now.

deploy-bot: Route switch accepted, rolling in ~45s.

oliver-sre: after routing, error-rate for T-789 dropped to near 0; latency is higher but correctness fixed.

dmitri-platform: CS notified, we've granted temporary quota exemptions for retries so idempotent clients can recover without hitting new rate limits. Audit log recorded.

zoe-ml-oncall: post-mitigation tasks: - gather full set of failing requests - reproduce locally with prefix-cache enabled - instrument eviction metrics - prepare patch to kernel optimization or revert change if root cause confirmed.

amy-support: sending customer communications now. Will keep new ticket comments with mitigation steps and ETA.

oliver-sre: lowering noise: setting alert threshold temporarily to avoid paging for now unless >1% global error or new increase. Keep watchlist running.

carla-eng-runtime: note: leaving KV-bypass flags for 3 tenants. Will coordinate rollback once patch validated and can do a staged re-enable with canary traffic.

zoe-ml-oncall: handing off to platform-oncall (dmitri) for overnight watch and rollback plan. My oncall shift ends in 40m. Putting summary below for handoff.

--- HANDOFF SUMMARY ---
incident: 1765001234
root cause (suspected): prefix-cache eviction + kernel optimization mismatch causing stale KV hits for prefix resolution
mitigations applied: KV-bypass for T-123/T-456/T-789; prefix-cache disabled for api/v1/generate; per-tenant rate-limits; T-789 routed to conservative variant C; quota exemptions granted for retries
current state: error rates down to <0.7% for impacted tenants; latency up for bypassed tenants (expected); KV-bypass flags still enabled
next steps: reproduce, patch/revert, perform staged re-enable, update status page, coordinate customer follow-ups
owner (overnight): dmitri-platform

dmitri-platform: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring, run the eviction reproducer overnight, and schedule a rollback/patch deploy window with eng-runtime tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

zoe-ml-oncall: thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident doc and tagging PRs.

incident-bot: incident 1765001234 marked as mitigated (active mitigations applied). Further updates will be appended to this thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
